description:
Fair Deal Property Your Trusted Partners for Residential Property Sales ,

Are delighted to present to you for sale No. 9 Country Meadows, an outstanding three bedroom family residence presented in turnkey condition, located just moments from Tuam Town and only a one minute drive from the motorway network.

This beautifully maintained owner occupied home has been impeccably cared for and tastefully upgraded by its current owners. Occupying a superb position overlooking a large, beautifully landscaped green area, providing an exceptional sense of space, light and privacy to the front of the property.

On arrival, the quality of finish and attention to detail is immediately apparent. The welcoming entrance hall is finished in contemporary white oak flooring and features a stylish vertical radiator, decorative stone feature wall and a beautifully painted stairwell, creating an elegant first impression.

The entrance hall leads into a bright and spacious living room, filled with natural light and finished with contemporary white oak flooring. A cleverly designed media wall creates an attractive focal point before double doors open into the fully upgraded kitchen and dining area.

The kitchen has been finished to an exceptional standard with modern white shaker style units, contrasting wooden worktops and quality appliances. The adjoining dining area is flooded with natural light through patio doors which open onto a beautifully landscaped rear garden featuring a spacious patio with a rainproof canopy, creating the perfect setting for outdoor dining and year round entertaining. A generously proportioned utility room along with a beautifully upgraded guest WC completes the ground floor accommodation.

The exceptional standard of finish continues upstairs where a beautifully presented landing leads to three beautifully appointed bedrooms, each finished with contemporary timber flooring. The family bathroom has been completely remodelled and now features a luxurious double low profile walk in shower along with premium quality fixtures and fittings, completing the accommodation of this outstanding home.

No. 9 Country Meadows represents a rare opportunity to acquire a great value beautifully presented turnkey residence in a highly convenient location close to Tuam Town, excellent schools, local amenities and the motorway network.

If you are searching for a stylish family home that offers outstanding value, an exceptional level of finish and a convenient location, then No. 9 Country Meadows is certain to exceed your expectations.

If this sounds like the home you have been waiting for, we would be delighted to hear from you and to arrange your viewing visit.
